name: Sea of Bygone Eras: Crown
description:
A Card Back won by achieving excellent results in open Genius Invokation TCG tournaments.
A golden palace gleaming with endless radiance, said to hold the lingering dreams of a great king. As the symbol of a duelist, it stands for an unyielding desire for victory and honor...
